status: CARTESIAN MATRICES -- the settled probe design of 2026-08-21.  LEVEL 1 y = op(x0,x1) over ALL ordered pairs of a shared set X; LEVEL 2 z = op(op(x0,x1), op(x2,x3)) over a subset X'.  The level-2 intermediates are never enumerated, deduped, capped or unioned -- they exist inside the expression.
scope: rust (static) + ruby (route C) only; the other ten wait
comparability: two rows compare position by position if and only if their (x_set_a, x_set_b) pair matches; both languages evaluate identical expressions on identical inputs, so there is no alignment step
absence_rule: a value a holder cannot represent is ABSENT from that holder's set -- the row is shorter and carries a different x_set id.  Nothing is coerced, wrapped or rounded.
ruby_stall_budget_note: RECORDED CHANGE 2026-08-21: 2 s, was 10 s. The previous run spent 550 s of 557 s waiting on `**` with BigDecimal.  A stall is recorded as ABORT and an ABORT is excluded from scoring in the numerator and the denominator both, so the shorter budget loses no measurement -- only wall clock.
vocabulary: super-node / sub-node / co-node / sub-tree; the OS-stopped outcome is ABORT
